scope: One semantic identification call per registered scripted candidate; no generation, utility scoring, commit or effect.
labels: Author expectations, not independent truth. Source IDs and expectations stay out of model messages.
stop_rules: Three consecutive model or contract failures stop remaining cases.
No retry, repair, replacement or hidden calls.
Source/request hash or input-budget mismatch prevents execution.
Keep raw model status separate from accepted structured disposition and actual identification findings.
